KEN.note: Training is for youth, not civil servants.

facts.fact: Power Learn Project, ILO, Microsoft and the Garissa County Government marked the rollout of a 25-week blended digital skills programme targeting 1,700 young people in Garissa and Turkana, with over 700 learners enrolled, funded by the Netherlands under PROSPECTS.
